content:
We recommend that you update your IAM policies to use the renamed API operations.
However, OpenSearch Service will continue to respect existing policies by internally
replicating the old API permissions. For example, if you currently have permission to
perform the CreateElasticsearchDomain operation, you can now make calls to both
CreateElasticsearchDomain (old API operation) and CreateDomain (new API operation).
The same applies to explicit denies. For a list of updated API operations, see the policy element
reference.
